paper.title_en: Odds Estimation for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Local Core Galaxies
paper.abstract_en: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are expected products of massive galaxy mergers, but identifying binaries in nearby galaxies remains challenging. We combine simulated massive-galaxy assembly histories from IllustrisTNG with a semi-analytic core-scouring model to connect observable core galaxy properties to the probability of hosting a bound SMBHB at z=0. We (i) construct a core galaxy population using an observationally motivated galaxy stellar mass function, (ii) model binary evolution through dynamical friction, stellar hardening, and gravitational-wave emission, and (iii) perform logistic regressions with five observable predictors: stellar mass deficit, stellar mass, central density, central velocity dispersion, and effective radius. The resulting models perform well on simulated systems, achieving a pseudo-$R^2$ of $0.51\pm0.03$, accuracy $0.95\pm0.01$, precision $0.92\pm0.03$, and recall $0.82\pm0.04$. Uncoalesced binaries are typically compact, with separations peaking near 0.3 pc, though only $\sim0.3\%$ emit in the pulsar timing array band. Applying the model to observed core galaxies, we identify eight nearby galaxies more likely than not to host SMBHBs. Of those eight host candidates, we note Messier 86 (NGC 4406) as a particularly likely example that was similarly identified using independent means and therefore warrants future follow-up.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将星系并合模拟与半解析核刮削模型结合，用逻辑回归把核星系可观测性质与z=0时束缚超大质量双黑洞存在概率联系起来，并给出PTA波段辐射比例约0.3%及候选核星系清单；方法与PTA和黑洞双星主题相关，结论具体但偏星系统计应用，理论深度有限，值得进一步查阅。
decision.title_zh: 本地核星系中超大质量双黑洞的概率估计
decision.abstract_zh: 超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）被认为是巨质量星系并合的预期产物，但在近邻星系中识别双黑洞仍然具有挑战性。我们将 IllustrisTNG 的巨质量星系组装历史模拟与半解析核刮削（core-scouring）模型相结合，把可观测的核星系性质与在 z=0 时拥有束缚 SMBHB 的概率联系起来。我们 (i) 使用一个由观测驱动的星系恒星质量函数构建核星系族群，(ii) 通过动力学摩擦、恒星硬化（stellar hardening）和引力波辐射来建模双星演化，(iii) 使用五个可观测预测量进行逻辑回归：恒星质量亏损、恒星质量、中心密度、中心速度弥散和有效半径。所得模型在模拟系统上表现良好，达到伪-$R^2$ 为 $0.51\pm0.03$、准确率 $0.95\pm0.01$、精确率 $0.92\pm0.03$、召回率 $0.82\pm0.04$。未并合的双星通常较为致密，分离度峰值接近 0.3 pc，不过只有 $\sim0.3\%$ 在脉冲星计时阵列波段辐射。将模型应用于观测到的核星系，我们识别出八个近邻星系，它们拥有 SMBHB 的可能性大于不可能。在这八个宿主候选中，我们指出 Messier 86 (NGC 4406) 是一个特别可能的例子，它此前也曾通过独立方法被类似地识别出来，因此值得未来跟进。
